瞓覺，其實係一件好有儀式感嘅事。 拉窗簾、調光暗、較埋枕頭角度，仲係差咁啲…？ 有人鐘意聽white noise，有人就鍾意聽另一種noise (害羞. ̫. 有儀式感，亦需要有宜式感：https://www.ikea.com.hk/zh/online-shopping/complete-sleep #睡好覺做好夢 Getting ready for bed can be quite the grand ritual! Blinds shut, lights dimmed and pillow perfectly fluffed, but still feeling like something’s missing? Some may turn up the white noise, some may prefer another type of noiseeee... Make IKEA a part of your sleeping ritual: https://www.ikea.com.hk/en/online-shopping/complete-sleep #WakeUpItsTimeToSleep
